banner.title: We use cookies
banner.text: They help us understand how the website is used, improve it, show you more relevant content and make browsing smoother. You choose which ones to allow in the settings.

preferences.title: Privacy settings
preferences.text: Here’s what we’d like to use your data for. You can change your mind at any time with the button in the bottom-left corner.

items.title: Essential cookies
items.description: Needed for the website to work and to remember your cookie choices. They’re always on.

items.title: Analytics
items.description: Lets us store information such as cookies to analyze visits (pages viewed, time on site) and improve the website.

items.title: Advertising
items.description: Lets us store advertising-related information such as cookies.

items.title: Advertising data
items.description: Lets us send user data to Google for advertising purposes.

items.title: Personalized ads
items.description: Lets us show you personalized ads.
